scope_definition: Newtonian gravitational interaction force and gravitational field for point masses and the external field of spherically symmetric sources, including force-field distinction, vector direction, inverse-square dependence, superposition, and near-Earth local-g interpretation for Grade 9-11 competitive-exam engineering.

authoritative_source_set.scope: Newtonian inverse-square force law, attractive direction, third-law pair and point/spherical-source applicability.
Gravitational field, inward radial field-line representation, inverse-square spatial dependence and variation of g with position.
Vector addition of multiple force contributions used to derive Newtonian field superposition.
Weight relation w = m g and the fact that gravitational acceleration/field strength varies with location.
Current CODATA provenance for the Newtonian constant of gravitation G when a numerical value is required.
Twenty-year TIMSS/TIMSS Advanced evidence on persistent gravity misconceptions across school grades, used only to select misconception falsifiers and not as Physics authority.

curriculum_boundaries: Include Newtonian gravitational force and field at Grade 9-11 competitive-exam engineering depth while keeping learner-facing depth independently governed downstream.
Include point-mass relations and the external equivalence of spherically symmetric sources; do not claim the same formula for arbitrary interior points of extended bodies.
Include vector superposition of gravitational fields at a common field point.
Treat approximately 9.8 N/kg as a local near-Earth-surface value, not a universal constant.
Exclude gravitational potential, potential energy, escape speed, orbital mechanics, shell-interior field derivations and general relativity from this request.
selected_design_decisions: Create PHY-GRAV-FORCE as a child of the existing interaction/NLM capability family instead of extending NLM with gravity-specific relations.
Create PHY-GRAV-FIELD as a child of PHY-GRAV-FORCE because field has independent ontology, relations, representations, misconceptions and verification logic.
Reuse existing vector-component and Newton-II gates rather than duplicating vector algebra or net-force reasoning inside Gravitation.
Require explicit source-to-field-point radial direction and inverse-square model conditions before any numerical substitution.
Use TIMSS misconception evidence to make continuous action of gravity and direction/source geometry explicit engineering invariants.
rejected_alternatives: Reject a monolithic PHY-GRAVITY gate because force, field, potential, energy and orbital dynamics have separable technical ownership.
Reject adding gravitational field directly to PHY-NLM-SECOND-LAW because that would mix a specific interaction/field model into a general dynamics gate.
Reject treating g = 9.8 N/kg as universally valid.
Reject introducing gravitational potential, energy or orbit relations before separate engineering requests establish their scope and prerequisites.
